question: Which globally unresolved but non-fresh identity axis gives the highest-value successor divergence without pretending inherited work is fresh or crossing into composition/convergence?

candidate_assessment.symbol_app_icon: SELECT. High shared-brand leverage, independent monochrome geometry, real cross-surface roles, deterministic incumbent source, and no need to invent product semantics. Existing Threshold K pressure can be managed explicitly as a frozen control.
candidate_assessment.wordmark_typography: REJECT. O3 remains incumbent and TYP-01 closed at zero survivors; successor work here would still be too close to the failed typography/editorial axis.
candidate_assessment.material_shape: DEFER. Mineral Theater plus extensive visual-world/hero evidence creates strong surface pressure and risks entanglement with parked CLR-01.
candidate_assessment.character_representation: DEFER. High value but depends more heavily on real app/content contexts and extensive CRV/CIR/VID ancestry.
candidate_assessment.static_world_imagery: REJECT NOW. Saturated and hero/static research remains paused.
candidate_assessment.iconography: DEFER. Functional iconography still needs real product vocabulary; decorative glyph work is not sufficient.
candidate_assessment.public_voice: DEFER. Important later but not a substitute for a visual-family divergence mechanism.

selected_program: SYM-01 — Primary Symbol / App-Icon Successor Divergence
incumbent: Threshold K is an unchanged historical working symbol candidate/control, not final logo authority.
selection_rationale: The symbol can be challenged without reopening CLR-01, MOT-01, STA-01, TYP-01, hero research, or application semantics.
Threshold K already has deterministic test-source readiness and realistic role evidence, so it can serve as a strong control rather than a hidden template.
A challenger can be structurally orthogonal to Threshold K and still be tested in monochrome, silhouette, compact scale, app-icon framing, website-header, and hero-prelude roles.
A zero-challenger-survivor result remains valid; the method does not require replacing Threshold K.
contamination_quarantine: Do not derive challenger geometry from Threshold K paths, three-field anatomy, emergent K counterform, or its dominant-right-mass balance.
Do not use O3/wordmark letterforms, CLR-01 colors, Mineral Theater material, MOT/STA treatments, hero/Quiet-Stage geometry, or product-state symbols as challenger identity carriers.
Historical symbol evidence may inform falsification and comparison only after challenger construction rules are frozen.
next_action: Freeze the SYM-01 successor method and deterministic challenger matrix before drawing or judging challengers.
hard_boundaries: No final logo/app-icon selection or production vector master.
No Threshold K retune or replacement by presumption.
No CLR-01 reentry, O3 redesign, material/color/motion/state-system work, app/site implementation, Stage motion, or Phase-C convergence.
audit_result: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
